Continuellement renouvelé avec de nouvelles musiques, des histoires inédites, des instruments sur mesure et des visuels stimulant les sens, Blue Man Group séduit un large public, toutes générations et cultures confondues. À propos de VStar Entertainment VStar Entertainment est l'un des principaux producteurs et promoteurs de spectacles familiaux en direct en Amérique du Nord. Fort de plusieurs décennies d'expérience à donner vie à des marques emblématiques sur scène, VStar crée des productions itinérantes immersives et de grande qualité qui captivent les publics de tous âges. This role will oversee the daily cleaning and upkeep of the Sturtevant facility by direct leadership of the custodial employee. Maintenance Engineers start up, regulate, repair, and shut down equipment. They monitor meters, gauges, and computerized controls to ensure that equipment operates safely and within established limits. They use sophisticated electrical and electronic test equipment to service, troubleshoot, repair, and monitor heating, cooling, and ventilation systems. Maintenance engineers also perform routine maintenance. They may completely overhaul or replace defective valves, gaskets, or bearings. In addition, they lubricate moving parts, replace filters, and remove soot and corrosion.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. Initially, this role will require a significant amount of hands-on work, but with ample prospects for progress and growth over time. The successful candidate will have experience managing accounting, tax, and FP&A in an international and production environment and an eagerness to solve challenging problems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, and regulations in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: E-Space 2027 Summer Internship, Arlington TX
jobs.description_text: As a company, E-Space does not believe in sticking to the path that has already been trodden. We are encountering new problems every day that need new ways of thinking. At E-Space, we use a first principles approach to solving tough technical challenges, and we look at problems differently. Most aerospace internships hand you one project, one team, and a report-out slide at the end of summer. E-Space is different: we’re a vertically integrated space company building spacecraft manufacturing capability from the ground up in Arlington, TX, and we’re writing the playbook, rather than following someone else’s. That means our interns aren’t boxed into a single lane. Our previous interns have worked across multiple disciplines in a single cohort, pitched and built their own passion projects, and watched ideas they proposed become hardware that flies, not something that gets shelved after a final presentation. If you want the mission and scale of a rapidly scaling aerospace and defense company without layers of process that come with it, this is where you should build it yourself!

jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker's Director of Industrial Partnerships, you will drive the commercial adoption of precipitation enhancement services across critical industries whose operations depend on reliable water and snowpack-fed resources. Your focus will be on identifying, developing, and partnering with operators in mining, oil & gas, hydroelectric power, and large-scale industrial water users across the Western United States and other water-stressed regions. You will translate Rainmaker's proven seeding technology into compelling value propositions for industrial operators and build a pipeline of revenue-generating partnerships with companies whose production, uptime, and license to operate are directly tied to water availability.

The ideal candidate is meticulous, comfortable with precision measurement equipment, and enjoys digging into a nonconforming part to figure out what happened and what to do about it.

Fabricated devices will be measured and compared at Rigetti to inform process development. What You'll Learn The intern will gain hands-on experience in the complete fabrication workflow for superconducting quantum circuits, including device layout, nanofabrication, microscopy, and process optimization. They will work alongside experienced researchers developing scalable fabrication technologies for quantum integrated circuits and contribute directly to advancing superconducting quantum hardware.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive execution across some of the most complex engineering programs at Rigetti. This role sits at the intersection of quantum hardware, systems engineering, and software infrastructure, ensuring that cross-disciplinary teams deliver integrated quantum systems on schedule. The Role Rigetti’s quantum systems require tight coordination between research scientists, hardware engineers, and control systems. As a Senior TPM, you will own the planning and execution of large technical programs that bring these components together into deployable quantum systems. You will operate in a fast-moving deep-tech environment where many efforts are research-driven and technically ambiguous, requiring strong judgment, technical understanding, and execution discipline.
